recs.x:
: standard, portable, lightweight, finely sandboxed, cross-language, compositional module (according to the wonderful talk linked below), and it seems so near, but this status quo of it being used so extensively in unikernel like applications, needing everything compiled ahead of time, feels like the area I want to see wasm expanding into not as a specification (the spec seems there!) but as a practicable doable thing, like what I want wasm components to be good for. Not just a distribution format but a runtime capability.
